title: thelypteris eriocarpa
intro: Thelypteris eriocarpa, commonly known as the cinnamon fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to the tropical and subtropical regions of Central and South America, and is often found growing in wetlands and along streams. The cinnamon fern has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties, which aid in the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of the cinnamon fern include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
